options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:

options.name: included_campaigns
options.doc: Controls which campaigns will be included in the output world.
options.doc_fr: Contrôles qui seront inclus dans le monde de la production.

options.name: victory_cache
options.doc: Adds additional locations received on mission victory.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute des emplacements supplémentaires pour la victoire de la mission.

options.name: bonus_mercenary_camps
options.doc: Adds mercenary camps to build missions that did not have them in vanilla.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute des camps de mercenaires pour construire des missions qui ne les avaient pas dans la vanille.

options.name: mercenary_allocation
options.doc:
Specifies what mercenaries can be hired in what missions.
vanilla:      Mercenary camps have their vanilla rosters.
              Non-vanilla camps will have 3-4 fixed tileset-appropriate mercs.
vanilla_plus: Random additional mercs are added to the mercenary camp pools
              in addition to vanilla/tileset rosters.
species:      Mercenary camps will supply mercenaries from 2~3 randomly-selected species.
full_random:  Mercenary camps will supply a random collection of mercenaries.

options.name: mercenaries_per_camp
options.doc:
Specifies the maximum number of mercenaries a single camp can offer.
Will not eliminate fixed/vanilla mercs specified by `vanilla` or `vanilla_plus` allocations.
